caption: The drawing features two adjacent rectangular panels with botanical patterns, centered on an off-white background. The left panel displays stylized leaves in green, yellow, and brown tones, outlined in black, with intricate vein details; the background is light beige with small brown dot clusters. The right panel has a dark brown or black base color with green leaves, yellow highlights, and clusters of small white flowers; there are also red fruit shapes and scattered blue heart-like motifs, all outlined in yellow or black lines. Both panels are bordered by fine black lines, and horizontal and vertical measurements ("6 3/8" and "4 5/16") are drawn around the panels. In the lower right corner of the paper, the text "EDWARD GRANT DEL. 1923" is inscribed. The composition is simple, with both panels arranged side by side and centered on the otherwise empty background.
title: Piece of Calico
